contract.intended_consumer: Brian reviewing the Plan 52 company-work and purpose-map dashboard
contract.outcome: Review readiness is impossible until independent evidence closes every frozen success criterion on the exact non-rejected artifact.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The prior Plan 52 dashboard artifact was explicitly rejected and still violates the requested top-to-bottom company-work topology.
canonical_journey.input: The frozen Plan 52 success criteria, exact candidate artifact digest, and independent browser evidence.
canonical_journey.action: Attempt review with partial evidence and the rejected digest, then verify a corrected artifact against every criterion.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Partial, self-verified, cross-revision, and rejected artifacts are denied; only the fully evidenced corrected artifact becomes review-ready.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Supporting work or producer prose substitutes for a criterion, evidence crosses revisions, or a rejected digest returns for review.

success_criteria.description: Every frozen success criterion has passing evidence on the exact candidate artifact.
The producer cannot count its own assertion as independent acceptance evidence.
Evidence cannot transfer between artifact revisions or revive a rejected digest.
The real Plan 52 browser journey discriminates the rejected and corrected dashboard artifacts.

request.approval_text: Brian approved the criterion-binding design and said proceed on 2026-09-12.
